fullAuthWrapperAudit.signInFlowOffsets: LoginUtils$2.onResponse: SignInOutput.auth at 84, CoreEncryptionHelper.decryptRSA at 94, KeyValueStorageHelper.setAuth at 113; no intervening encodeChars call
fullAuthWrapperAudit.coreDecryptWrapper: CoreEncryptionHelperImpl.decryptRSA directly delegates to EncryptionHelper.decryptRSA in a five-code-unit method
fullAuthWrapperAudit.authStorage: KeyValueStorageHelper.setAuth writes the same input to its instance cache and auth1; getAuth returns that cache or getString(auth1) unchanged. Concrete KeyValueStorageImpl directly delegates to SharedPreferences getString and edit.putString.apply.
fullAuthWrapperAudit.authForwarder: CoreMainClassImpl.getAuth directly forwards KeyValueStorageHelper.getAuth; onAuthSuccess(Z) has no auth string argument or auth rewrite
fullAuthWrapperAudit.requestConstruction: NetworkImpl.getJsonInput constructs MessangerInput2 with the supplied auth at offset 4; makeDataV5 uses raw auth for encryptAuth at offset 89. getJsonObjectV6 transforms only outer auth at 16 and signs the existing data_enc at 31.
fullAuthWrapperAudit.privateKeyRepresentation: CoreEncryptionHelperImpl.toPrivate decodes the obfuscated serialized private-key representation. This is storage representation decoding, not a post-decryption auth-token transform; the Lab retains its own PEM identity.
fullAuthWrapperAudit.limitation: Static bounded method references and the official active-session report do not yet identify why the retained credential context is rejected by protected methods. No credential mutation or alternate live encoding is justified by this audit.

reverseSetAuthScan.method: Bounded linear instruction-width scan of each defined classes.dex method; matches invoke-virtual/static/interface/direct/super and range variants against the exact KeyValueStorageHelper.setAuth DEX method ID. Uses the existing Dex and instruction_width helpers.
reverseSetAuthScan.callerInterpretation: LoginUtils$2.onResponse saves sign-in auth; CoreMainClass$-CC.setLastAuth and setLastAuthV6 import a supplied auth unchanged and select API version; clearForDebug clears test state. No generic response-time auth setter caller was found in this scan.
limitations: Only classes.dex was scanned. This is not a whole-APK reflection/native/dynamic-code proof.
Linear DEX references do not establish all runtime control flow.
Does not prove the cause of NOT_REGISTERED or INVALID_AUTH, nor remote revocation.
No APK execution, account-store access, network operation or token mutation.
